notes: Morgue record schema per blueprint §8.3. The Morgue is the administrative death archive — it answers 'WHAT DIED?' No burials recorded yet. This agrees with the Semmaterry page: 'No burials recorded yet. No tombstones exist because no artifacts have been buried. The registry currently holds active artifacts only — nothing has died, and nothing has been invented to fill the dirt.'

tombstone_schema.burial_date: date buried in Semmaterry™ (null until buried)
tombstone_schema.description: Semmaterry™ tombstone interface element per blueprint §8.6. EVERY buried artifact gets a tombstone. Do not invent epitaphs without approval if they imply Kanon.
tombstone_schema.epitaph: Kreator-approved epitaph only — null until approved
tombstone_schema.family_tree_ref: reference to the artifact's family-tree record
